commit_message:
[Merged] [autofit] Speed up computation of `af_reverse_character_map_new`. (1/4)

Using HarfBuzz's API functions to construct the reverse map is too slow; we
have to call `hb_ot_layout_lookup_get_glyph_alternates` far too often
because it can only handle a single glyph at a time.  For this reason we are
going to parse the GSUB table by ourselves.

The new non-local functions are `af_parse_gsub` and `af_map_lookup`.

* src/autofit/afgsub.c, src/autofit/afgsub.h: New files for parsing,
  validating, and mapping the `SingleSubst` and `AlternateSubst` subtable
  types of a GSUB table.

* src/autofit/autofit.c, src/autofit/rules.mk (AUTOF_DRV_SRC): Updated.

fix_commit_message:
* src/autofit/afgsub.c (af_map_lookup): Fix handling of lookup type 7.

Fixes issue #1356.
agent_reasoning: Merged diff composed mechanically by cherry-picking fix 53b9319bff2d on top of intro cda418a4a5a2 via git's 3-way merge. Vulnerability (LogicError): A logic error in the new `af_map_lookup` function (introduced in FreeType 2.14.0 as part of a GSUB-parsing speedup) causes the process to freeze when a GSUB lookup table contains more than one extension subtable (type 7). The outer variable `lookupType` is mutated during the first loop iteration, breaking all subsequent iterations. Root cause: The variable `lookupType` is declared outside the while loop but is overwritten inside it when an extension lookup (type 7) is encountered. This mutation is not reset between iterations, so all subsequent subtables in the same lookup are handled with the wrong type, producing an incorrect `subtable` pointer and ultimately an infinite traversal loop over invalid coverage data.
